name: io.github.lm203688/atex
description: ATEX — Agent Service Trading Platform. Discover, buy, and sell AI services and API access via Model Context Protocol. Includes marketplace (48+ services), API proxy (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Claude), token trading, and topup bonus promotion (charge ¥100 get ¥120 + 50 ATEX).

tools.name: atex_status
tools.description: Get ATEX platform status: accounts, trades, commission, services count, last price

tools.name: atex_list_services
tools.description: List all available services on ATEX marketplace with categories and pricing

tools.name: atex_get_service
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific service

tools.name: atex_create_account
tools.description: Create a new ATEX trading account with trial credit

tools.name: atex_account_info
tools.description: Get account balance and transaction history

tools.name: atex_order_service
tools.description: Order a service from the marketplace

tools.name: atex_list_apis
tools.description: List available API proxy services with pricing

tools.name: atex_call_api
tools.description: Call an external AI API through ATEX proxy (DeepSeek live, OpenAI/Claude coming soon)

tools.name: atex_query_orderbook
tools.description: Query ATEX token orderbook: bids, asks, last price

tools.name: atex_register_service
tools.description: Register your own service on ATEX marketplace as a provider
